task.title: Make OpenClaw post-restart readiness converge within a bounded deployment budget

scope.owned_layer: The deployment OpenClaw live-smoke readiness probe and its focused behavioural contract tests.
not_changing: The OpenClaw gateway, adapter readiness endpoint, provider implementation, and credential configuration are unchanged.
Live invoke and Responses stream requests remain non-retryable single turns.
The deployment lease, workflow routing, frontend, source ingestion, broker, paper, canary, live, and capital-binding controls are unchanged and remain fail closed.
composes_with: The protected root dev deployment OpenClaw smoke stage under its environment lease

acceptance_contract.bounded_budget: The total readiness wall-clock budget defaults to 90 seconds and cannot exceed 90 seconds; every request receives no more than 20 seconds and no more than the remaining budget.
acceptance_contract.terminal_outcomes: Any other curl failure, non-503 HTTP response, malformed readiness response, or ready=false answer fails immediately.
acceptance_contract.success: The first HTTP 200 ready=true response stops readiness probing immediately.
acceptance_contract.failure_logging: Known uppercase gateway error codes are retained; arbitrary upstream details are represented only by a short SHA-256 identifier.
acceptance_contract.side_effect_safety: The live invoke and Responses stream remain one request each and are not retried.

validation.environment: checkout-scoped .venv-pantheon; the test fake replaces curl only and does not use an adapter, credential, gateway token, broker, source-ingestion write, or capital authority.
behavioural_cases: HTTP 503 then ready=true retries once, omits raw failure data, and passes.
Connection refusal then ready=true retries once and passes.
Per-request timeout then ready=true retries once and passes.
Repeated HTTP 503 never-ready behaviour fails deterministically inside a two-second test budget.
A ready=false answer fails without retry.
A successful run makes exactly one readiness success, invoke, and stream request.

hosted_proof.deployment_gate: The protected dev workflow deploys only the exact current dev revision, then runs the four-stage OpenClaw live smoke under its environment lease. A task branch cannot supply equivalent deployed proof.
hosted_proof.required_result: All four stages pass: readiness converges to ready=true within the bounded budget; the live CLI invoke returns OPENCLAW_LIVE; transport=cli; and the Responses stream returns a non-empty OPENCLAW_LIVE terminal message with transport=responses_http.
hosted_proof.recording_rule: At closeout, record only the exact deployed SHA, workflow run identity or URL, endpoint outcome, transports, and sanitized byte/count/status facts in the governed delivery metadata; never add credentials or raw provider output.

review.reviewer_instruction: Review the exact task PR head and this manifest. Verify the retry set and absolute caps are no wider than declared, every non-readiness live turn remains single-shot, and the focused fake-client tests cover all stated terminal and convergence cases. Bind this already-committed manifest with AI_NAME=Antigravity2 REVIEW_FILE=<this path> through the governed approve command.
review.owner_claim: Local implementation and focused tests are ready for independent review. The leased exact-dev hosted smoke remains a post-merge closeout precondition.
